items.prep: stem and middle piece removed, quartered

instructions: Put the tomatoes, salt, garlic, black pepper, cayenne, and vinegar in a food processor fitted with the S blade.
Add the olive oil slowly while the mixture is blending on medium-low speed.
notes: Tomatoes are sliced into quarters before going into the food processor.
source: Yidi's own recipe — submitted as pasted text
title: Tomato Dip
